quotes.text: Whenever I sell stocks, the per-order charges and other deductions are not clearly displayed. Customers should be able to see the complete brokerage, transaction charges, taxes, and total deductions before confirming every order.
Just pray you never have to contact them. They give the same automated responses which is really frustrating.
We can’t able to track the invested stocks update. Once market closed it is opened properly.
